post.title: Virtio vda sits on /dev/sda
post.body: The housing disk is one map: guest /dev/vda to host /dev/sda. ISOs add connectivity over time. Ubuntu Server, Kali Desktop, and Zorin are the present tracks. Fedora and other Debian rebuilds stay optional. macOS Sequoia and Windows 11 stay operator-provided onsite ISOs and are not bundled here.

post.title: VNC and nbd0 stay in different zones
post.body: nbd0 is a block export. VNC is a display path. They do not share a namespace. The calculator puts VNC on 127.0.0.1 display zones 100+ and locks nbd0 in zone 300 with vnc_attach denied. That is isolation, not a pentest attach.

post.title: HTTPS cert broadcast on the LVM cache
post.body: The desktop agent writes the virtio disk. The cloud agent builds a searchable cache and serves it on 127.0.0.1:8443. The public cert is at /cert.pem. The key is not. systemctl start hum-housing.target is the concert. Dark-web and nbd0 attach stay off the set list.

post.title: One sign-in covers URL, package, and display dial-in
post.body: The SQL login desk is the collision point. A future APK or PKG only opens the same HTTPS origin. VNC dial-in, if used, stays on the loopback display zone after that session. Dummy rails keep each guest track inside its /30. HTTPS 443, housing DNS 53, and login 8088 are the 2026 listener pattern.
